description.value:
You fire a paralytic dart at a creature you can see within range. It must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become poisoned for the duration, and while poisoned this way it is also paralyzed. At the end of each of its turns, it may attempt another Constitution save, ending the power on a success.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 6th level or higher, you may target one additional creature per slot level beyond 5th, provided the targets are within 30 feet of one another when chosen.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 5
